articulation.label: name
articulation.alt: name: /n/ → /eɪ/ → /m/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/e/: Start with the tongue mid-front.
/ɪ/: Raise the front tongue; narrow the jaw gap.
/m/: Close both lips; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Keep each vowel glide inside one syllable.

articulation.label: pen
articulation.alt: pen: /p/ → /ɛ/ → /n/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: book
articulation.alt: book: /b/ → /ʊ/ → /k/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /b/: Close lips briefly; release into the next vowel.
/ʊ/: Back tongue, relaxed; lips rounded.
/k/: Back of tongue meets the soft palate; release.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

articulation.label: help
articulation.alt: help: /h/ → /ɛ/ → /l/ → /p/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /h/: Gentle breath; mouth prepares for the vowel.
/ɛ/: Front tongue; open the jaw a little more.
/l/: Tip at the ridge; air passes round the sides.
/p/: Close the lips, then release the air.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.

cards.title: Five words to hear and use
sections: not large in size. Puck has a small room with a big window.
made or bought recently. Mia has a new cup.
used to ask or state how long someone has lived. How old is your brother?
The hard material that comes from trees. This table is made of wood.
moving or happening quickly. That car is fast.
Listen to each word. Point or act to show its meaning. Say one word, then one short sentence. Ask for help with spelling patterns you have not learned yet.
